name: SigNoz Observability
description: Auto-detects repos on open, scans them for OpenTelemetry instrumentation, and polls SigNoz for fresh exceptions after every turn — surfacing a service/error summary on the SecondStatusLine and in memory.

signoz_endpoint.description: Base URL of the SigNoz query API (e.g. https://signoz.example.com or http://localhost:3301).

credential_profile.description: Name of the ~/.aish/credentials [profile:*] section holding SIGNOZ_API_KEY. Secrets NEVER go in session env.

poll_window_secs.description: How far back to search for exceptions on each poll.

poll_every.description: Timer cadence for the turn-independent poller (compact duration).

dedup_ttl_secs.description: Suppress re-alerting the same (service,fingerprint) within this window.

scan_on_detect.description: Run the instrumentation scanner when a new repo is detected.
